I’ve built the model around **Weekly support capacity**, with the target you stated: **at least 100 tickets per week**, with no deadline.

- **Keep current staffing** holds the current team at **80 tickets per week**.
- **Add one specialist** adds **one specialist**.
- Your stated specialist capacity is **about 20 tickets per specialist per week**, with a **10–30** range.
- The model uses your definition: existing capacity plus added specialist capacity.

Olumi also added a throughput-uncertainty risk; the specialist-start-delay risk is retained but excluded because you gave no deadline.
